purpose: Retain exact initial seeder and tests underlying the independent negative observations after the maintained files were fixed.
source: Full initial file text captured by this reviewer's tool reads; expected SHA256 values captured before fixes and in the initial review/probe results.
method: Manual reconstruction via apply_patch; SHA256 equality checked with shasum -a 256. No reconstruction executable helper was created.
historical_probe_contract: probe_discovery_seeder.py intentionally demonstrates the old accepting behavior and targets the maintained source by default. It will refuse/raise when run against the fixed implementation. Do not overwrite seeder-preliminary-probes.json to reinterpret historical failures as a pass. The fixed helper/results are separate artifacts.
replay_limit: The snapshots retain their original __file__-relative root assumptions and are historical evidence, not standalone scripts to execute in-place. A replay must bind the source to disposable fixture roots as the retained probe does and write a new result artifact; no corpus execution is authorized by these snapshots.
native_lineage_limit: The initial observations were raw structured JSON reports, not immutable native RecordReview bundles. Cite them as prior_review evidence and links, never fabricate previous_occurrences native review identities.
preservation: Original negative helper, results and reports were not edited. No Git or corpus changes were made.
